status: frozen before any regional temperature result, thermal source map, v17E inverse coefficient, v17E lensing score, or v17F result existed
pre_result_action_lift_amendment: Version 1.0.1 adds the covariant source/propagator action and its one-metric lensing obstruction before any upstream thermal or lensing result. It changes no source, length grid, fit, score, or gate.
purpose: Conditional action-selection diagnostic: determine whether one source-derived thermal scale plus at most one universal propagation length can reproduce the apparent residual-field extent and morphology without the flexible three-scale v17E interpolation.

authorization.required_v17e_status: completed Sigma v17E thermal-stress transfer diagnostic
authorization.rule: Do not run v17F if v17E fails. The v17E family is a strict superset of the one-source one-length v17F family, so a v17F run cannot rescue a failed source-information gate.

projected_root_equation.mediator_equation: Helmholtz mediator: (1-L_sigma^2 nabla_perp^2) s_sigma(x)=q_b(x), with q_b in {q_total,q_contrast}
projected_root_equation.one_metric_response: delta_kappa_sigma=beta_sigma s_sigma; delta_gamma_1 and delta_gamma_2 are the unique E-mode shears derived from the same delta_kappa_sigma
projected_root_equation.physical_interpretation: q_b supplies object-dependent size and geometry; L_sigma is one universal correlation length that can broaden but may not replace the source scale; beta_sigma controls amplitude but cannot change R50 or R80
projected_root_equation.claim_boundary: This is the projected weak-field signature of a candidate mediator, not a covariant action. Helmholtz/Yukawa propagation is established prior art. A passing result selects a scale mechanism for action derivation, not a novel theory.

conditional_action_lift.covariant_diagnostic: Baryonic thermal stress-energy in the Landau frame: h_mn=g_mn+u_m u_n, S_mn=h_m^a h_n^b T^b_ab, and J_T=sqrt(S_mn S^mn)/(sqrt(3)c^2); for an isotropic fluid J_T=abs(p)/c^2 and projects to the q_total/q_contrast source family.
conditional_action_lift.action_under_test: Canonical scalar Helmholtz source action S_source=integral sqrt(-g)[-L_sigma^2 nabla_m s nabla^m s/2-s^2/2+b_sigma s J_T], after field normalization
conditional_action_lift.euler_lagrange_source: (1-L_sigma^2 Box)s=b_sigma J_T; the static limit is the v17F Helmholtz mediator before projection and normalization
conditional_action_lift.healthy_source_sector_conditions: L_sigma^2>0 gives positive canonical kinetic and gradient energy and mediator mass m_sigma=1/L_sigma; L_sigma=0 is a nondynamical algebraic source response.
conditional_action_lift.exact_incompleteness: With minimal metric coupling this scalar changes the Weyl metric only through source-quadratic scalar/interaction stress. With a purely conformal universal matter metric its direct linear contributions to Phi and Psi cancel from (Phi+Psi)/2. It therefore does not derive the assumed linear delta_kappa_sigma response.
conditional_action_lift.required_completion_if_data_pass: Derive a metric-active scalar-stress, universal disformal, or dynamical vector/tensor completion from one action and recompute both weak-field potentials; do not append a lens multiplier.

propagation.L_sigma_zero_interpretation: source-derived scale only; no propagation-length constant
propagation.maximum_L_sigma_interpretation: identifiability boundary only; a selected 300 kpc endpoint fails the length-identification gate

fit.static_baseline: unchanged v16B internal-only response fitted on the training cluster and frozen before the thermal increment
fit.thermal_parameter: one real beta_sigma fitted on the training cluster across convergence, shear_1, and shear_2 together
fit.coefficient_sign: beta_sigma must be finite and strictly positive in both transfer directions
fit.selection: among candidates with finite strictly positive beta_sigma in both directions, choose one common source family and L_sigma by minimum symmetric leave-one-cluster-out full-field NRMSE; each directional beta_sigma is fitted only on its training cluster and transferred unchanged; if no positive candidate exists, retain the unconstrained minimum only to document failure
fit.tie_break: smaller L_sigma, then q_total before q_contrast
fit.post_selection_joint_fit: After all spent gates pass, fit one beta_sigma jointly on both spent clusters and freeze {source family,L_sigma,beta_sigma} before any untouched cluster is opened.

scale_diagnostic.centering: required and predicted fields use their own field-energy centroids only for the extent diagnostic; full-field scores retain absolute position and orientation
scale_diagnostic.amplitude_invariance: beta_sigma cancels from both predicted radii
source_vs_propagation_decision: If L_sigma=0 passes, the apparent halo extent is source-derived in this diagnostic and no propagation-length constant is justified.
If an identified nonzero common L_sigma passes, retain one universal propagation length for covariant action derivation.
If amplitude passes while either radius fails, the thermal source can correlate with strength but does not explain halo size.
If size passes while full-field alignment or topology fails, the scale mechanism is useful but lacks the required directional carrier.

decision_rule: Advance a root-scale mechanism only if every gate passes simultaneously with one common source family and L_sigma.
A passing L_sigma is a candidate universal physical constant, not an object radius; source geometry must still generate object-to-object scale variation.
A passing projected equation must be derived from one healthy covariant action with one physical metric before a holdout is opened.
Do not add a second length, fractional exponent, object label, private orientation, cluster normalization, or lensing-only coefficient after failure.
If v17F fails, reject the tested instantaneous gas-stress plus single finite-range mediator and follow the v17 mechanism decision tree rather than tuning it.
